decisions.nm: Plaintiff M70/2011 v. Minister for Immigration (Malaysia arrangement)
decisions.pe: Australia agreed to send 800 asylum seekers to Malaysia in exchange for refugees. The High Court said this was unlawful because Malaysia was not bound to protect them.
decisions.pi: Australia sepakat mengirim 800 pencari suaka ke Malaysia sebagai tukar dengan pengungsi. Pengadilan Tinggi menyatakan ini tidak sah karena Malaysia tidak terikat untuk melindungi mereka.

decisions.nm: NZYQ v. Minister for Immigration (indefinite detention)
decisions.pe: A stateless Rohingya man had been held for years because no country would take him. The High Court said this was unlawful, and more than 100 people were released.
decisions.pi: Seorang pria Rohingya tanpa kewarganegaraan ditahan bertahun-tahun karena tidak ada negara yang mau menerimanya. Pengadilan Tinggi menyatakan ini tidak sah, dan lebih dari 100 orang dibebaskan.

decisions.pe: Indefinite detention of a stateless man (overruled in 2023).
decisions.pi: Penahanan tanpa batas seorang pria tanpa kewarganegaraan (dibatalkan pada 2023).

decisions.pe: Privative clause and access to the High Court in migration cases.
decisions.pi: Klausul pembatasan dan akses ke Pengadilan Tinggi dalam perkara migrasi.

decisions.nm: Fair Work Ombudsman v McCrystal Agricultural Services Pty Ltd
decisions.ct: Federal Circuit and Family Court of Australia (Division 2)
decisions.pe: Penalties ($43,000 company, $5,500 director) for fining PALM workers under an alcohol policy and other unlawful deductions (Fair Work Act).
decisions.pi: Denda (43.000 dolar untuk perusahaan, 5.500 dolar untuk direktur) karena mendenda pekerja PALM berdasarkan aturan alkohol dan potongan upah lain yang melanggar hukum (Fair Work Act).

decisions.nm: Fair Work Ombudsman v NQ Powertrain (labour hire)
decisions.ct: Federal Circuit and Family Court of Australia
decisions.pe: Court-ordered penalty of about $106,000 against a labour-hire company that underpaid 87 visa holders engaged under the Pacific Labour Scheme and Seasonal Worker Programme.
decisions.pi: Pengadilan menjatuhkan denda sekitar 106.000 dolar kepada perusahaan penyalur tenaga kerja yang kurang membayar 87 pemegang visa dalam Pacific Labour Scheme dan Seasonal Worker Programme.

decisions.nm: Fair Work Ombudsman v Maroochy Sunshine Pty Ltd
decisions.pe: Penalties against a Queensland labour-hire operator for 'appalling' treatment of 22 Vanuatu workers under the Seasonal Worker Programme (underpaid $77,649).
decisions.pi: Denda bagi penyalur tenaga kerja di Queensland karena perlakuan yang “sangat buruk” terhadap 22 pekerja Vanuatu dalam Seasonal Worker Programme (kurang bayar 77.649 dolar).
